# OCTACORE Fitness

> Premium athletic gym brand operating in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Established in 2019.
> Brand Tagline: FITNESS • PASSION • SPIRIT
> Primary Website: https://octacorefitness.com

## Brand & Philosophy
OCTACORE Fitness provides an athletic, high-intensity, and scientifically structured training environment. The brand is built around three foundational pillars:
- Fitness: Developing physical capacity, strength, and athletic longevity.
- Passion: Bringing focus, intent, and dedicated discipline to every workout session.
- Spirit: Cultivating mental resilience and continuous personal transformation.

## Facilities & Locations

### 2. OCTACORE Fitness, Airoli (Corporate & High-Performance Campus)
- Address: Unit D-1, South Block, Empire, Reliable Tech Park, Thane–Belapur Road, Gavate Wadi, MIDC, Airoli, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400708, India.

- URL: https://octacorefitness.com/locations/airoli

## Core Programs & Disciplines
- Strength Training: Progressive overload barbell mechanics, Olympic lifting, and hypertrophy.
- Cardio Training: Tactical interval conditioning, curved treadmills, and lung capacity expansion.
- Personal Coaching: Bespoke 1-on-1 biomechanical coaching, mobility screens, and personalized program design.
- Yoga & Group Conditioning: Guided mobility, cohort endurance, and functional core resilience.
- Extended Disciplines: Functional training, kettlebells, boxing, kickboxing, MMA, and karate (availability to be confirmed at branch desk).

## Membership Structure
All pricing is provided upon enquiry to ensure customized coaching onboarding and accurate corporate/promotional packaging:
- Monthly Intake: Flexible single-month gym access.
- Quarterly Protocol (90-Day): Targeted conditioning cycle with biometric screening.
- Annual Elite Pass: 365-day access with multi-club passport (Nerul & Airoli).
- Corporate Executive Pass: Subsidized group enrollment for tech park teams.
